methods.name: Seismicity lineament detection (H50-B)
methods.citation: Ouillon, Ducorbier & Sornette (2008), Tectonophysics 456, 42; Ouillon & Sornette (2011), J. Geophys. Res. 116, B01303
methods.used: corridor orientation via 2-D inertia tensor; Poisson nearest-neighbour crossover r_c=1.61 km; the 2-D triangle-area analogue of the 3-D tetrahedron-volume statistic is this project's own adaptation and is unverified

methods.name: Marginal-credit emission
methods.used: a dot is emitted iff its kernel credit k exceeds 0.2*s; binary support dominates any graded map

caveats: The private leaderboard is unknown to this project; no number here is a leaderboard score.
Historical local H50-B/Seis-Ridge comparisons are archive-only, not independently reproduced in this session; the current H50-S1 excludes mixed-network ComCat and unlicensed derived scarp inputs.
